claims.statement: Pinned tutorial applies to FPT/GHEC/GHES and contrasts curl/CLI examples; its cloud api.github.com URLs are not demonstrated GHES endpoint adaptation. CLI include is navigation only; linked API/auth/webhook pages are not certified reviewed by reference.

Queries use read:project and mutations use project in classic-token examples; App installation permission models must not be equated with classic scopes. Linking repositoryId during createProjectV2 additionally requires repository Contents permission. No token creation, scope escalation or auth login executed.

CLI variables use -F for typed number/Boolean/null and -f for strings. Placeholder substitution, escaping and target identity require separate implementation verification; sample scripts and response IDs are not receipts.
Project numbers with organization/user owner resolve project node IDs. Listing examples return first 20 projects without cursor traversal; they cannot substantiate exhaustive estate inventory.

Field discovery returns first 20 fields; mutations need field ID plus single-select option ID or iteration ID. Common-field projection gives name/ID, not full option/iteration configuration. Sample __typename output is not requested by the shown common-field query.

Item query limits items to 20, field values to 8 and assignees to 10, returning selected text/date/single-select values and draft/issue/PR projections. Missing types and pagination prevent exhaustive assessment or backup claims.
Inaccessible project items can return REDACTED; absence of visible content is unknown permission coverage, never compliant emptiness or authority to reveal private repository content.

Adding existing issue/PR uses content node ID and returns project-item ID; repeated existing item addition returns its existing ID. This idempotency statement does not establish draft creation or arbitrary mutation idempotency.
Source requires separate addProjectV2ItemById and updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue calls; a later update failure can leave the addition present. No atomic transaction or rollback guarantee is supplied.

Draft creation takes title/body and returns project-item ID, not an underlying repository issue receipt. Project setting mutation changes title/readme/description and can change public visibility; tutorial is not approval for publication.

Custom text/number/date heading demonstrates only a text mutation. Single-select updates use option IDs and iteration updates allow active or completed iteration IDs. Unsupported shapes and stale IDs require separate validation.

Assignees, labels, milestone and repository belong to underlying issues/PRs, not project item custom-field mutations. Linked assign/label/update/transfer mutations carry distinct repository write permissions and effects; no linked-page coverage or write approval inferred.

deleteProjectV2Item removes the selected project item; no underlying repository issue deletion or draft recovery guarantee is demonstrated. Creating a project requires owner node ID and name; sample lookup/creation is not actual provisioning.

Project webhook overview describes HTTP POST to configured endpoint and projects_v2_item reference, not demonstrated delivery, signature validation, retries or authorized receiver deployment. All source claims remain reference evidence, with no accepted policy, rights clearance or native behavior receipt.
